info.title: InSync API
info.description:
Formal HTTP API contract derived from the current server/ implementation.

Source of truth: Express routers and serialize* functions.

Compatibility: OpenAPI 3.0.3 (Apifox / Swagger friendly).
CoupleSummary (inside /userinfo) and CoupleSpace (/couple-space) are different models.
Upload success body is { key, url } without message. Lists are not paginated.

post.description: 已有有效邀请且未 regenerate 时复用现有邀请码；regenerate=true 时作废旧码并新建。

get.description: 按 remainingDays、nextOccurrenceDate 排序；未绑定关系时返回空数组（仍为 200）。

200.description:
List sorted by remainingDays then nextOccurrenceDate.
Empty array when user is not bound (still 200).

patch.description: 请求体为全量 AnniversaryPayload，非 partial。
可修改标题、描述、状态、目标日期、预算或地点名称；至少提供一个字段。

delete.description: 软删除，响应返回删除后的 wish 实体。

get.description: 含 legacy wish_records.media_urls 合成项（id 可能为负数）；无分页。

post.description: media 可选；有媒体时会写入 album_media 并设置封面。
请求体为原始二进制。仅允许 `album` 图片/视频和 `interact` 音频，最大 100 MiB；服务端依据 Content-Type 白名单派生对象后缀，不信任文件名，并在写入前核对文件签名/容器标识。该检查用于头部识别，不等同于完整解码或编解码轨道校验。成功响应为 `{ key }`，无 message；对象读取 URL 由各自的授权资源接口签发。

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Upload folder. `album` accepts supported image/video MIME types; `interact` accepts supported audio MIME types.

201.description: Uploaded — body is `{ key }` without message

400.description: Unsupported folder or empty upload body

415.description: Unsupported declared media type or mismatched media signature for folder

get.description: Requires the exact relationship to remain bound and the caller to be one of its two members. Pages are returned in chronological order; beforeId is an exclusive server-message-id cursor. Private audio object keys and signed URLs are never returned.

200.description: Chronological page of authorized chat history

400.description: Invalid relationship id, cursor, or page size

get.summary: 获取伴侣聊天语音播放地址
get.description: Requires an authenticated sender/receiver who is still a member of this message's currently bound relationship. Key-backed audio returns a 300-second signed URL. Legacy URL-backed audio remains readable while the relationship is bound. Responses are private and not cacheable.

404.description: Audio message not found in a current authorized relationship

get.description:
Not a JSON REST endpoint. Clients open a WebSocket to
`ws(s)://<host>/partner-chat?token=<jwt>` (or Bearer on upgrade). Set optional `deliveryAck=1` to negotiate client delivery acknowledgements; the server advertises `deliveryAckVersion: 1` in `ready`, and clients send ACKs only after that negotiation.

Requires an active bound couple relationship; otherwise upgrade is rejected
with HTTP 403.

Client → server message schemas:
- PartnerChatClientMessageText
- PartnerChatClientMessageAudio (exactly one of `audioObjectKey` or legacy `audioUrl`)
- PartnerChatClientDeliveryAck
- PartnerChatClientRead

New object keys must belong to the authenticated sender under `interact/<userId>/`. The server does not echo private keys or signed URLs over WebSocket; clients fetch playback URLs from `GET /partner-chat/messages/{id}/audio-url`.

Server → client message schemas:
- PartnerChatServerReady
- PartnerChatServerMessage
- PartnerChatServerDelivery
- PartnerChatServerReadReceipt
- PartnerChatServerError

For negotiated clients, `sending` means transport was attempted but the recipient runtime has not acknowledged it; `sent` follows the recipient acknowledgement. Legacy clients without negotiation retain transport-acceptance delivery behavior to avoid duplicate replay.

Message `id` values are **strings** (unlike HTTP resource ids).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: JWT when not using Authorization header

parameters.name: deliveryAck
parameters.description: Set to 1 to negotiate receiver acknowledgement support.

401.description: Unauthorized upgrade rejection (plain text, not ErrorMessage JSON)

message.description: Human-readable error message (no stable machine code yet)

ErrorMessage.description:
Uniform HTTP error body used by `HttpError`, JSON parse failures,
unknown routes, and unhandled 500s.

DateOnlyNullable.description: Calendar date or null when unset

LoginUser.description: Slim user returned by login only. Full profile is `User` from `/userinfo`.

avatar.description: Avatar URL or null (field name is `avatar`, not avatarUrl)

PartnerSummary.description: Partner card used inside CoupleSummary and CoupleSpace

daysInLove.description: Days since anniversaryDate; null if unbound or no date

CoupleSummary.description:
Embedded couple **summary** on `User` from `/userinfo`.
This is NOT the same model as `CoupleSpace` from `/couple-space`.
Overlapping semantics (isBound, daysInLove, partner, anniversary date)
exist in both, but CoupleSpace also exposes relationship + activeInvite.

gender.description: Returned by GET/PUT userinfo; not updatable via current PUT body

coupleStatus.description:
Latest couple_relationships.status for this user, or null.
Overlaps conceptually with `couple.isBound` — do not collapse in contract.

User.description:
Canonical user entity from `/userinfo` serializeUser.

Client gaps (types only; runtime JSON still includes these fields):
- Web AuthUser/UserProfile: often omits birthday, gender, coupleStatus, createdAt, updatedAt
- App AuthUser: often omits nested `couple` while keeping coupleStatus

nickname.description: Empty string is stored as null

avatar.description: Empty string is stored as null

signature.description: Empty string is stored as null

birthday.description: Optional valid YYYY-MM-DD date that cannot be in the future; null clears the stored birthday

status.description: e.g. pending, used (string as returned; not a closed enum in code)

CoupleSpace.description:
Full couple-space payload from `/couple-space`.
Distinct from `CoupleSummary` on User. Do not merge schemas.

regenerate.description:
If true, expires the current pending invite and creates a new code.
Omitted or false reuses an existing valid pending invite when present.
Not validated by Zod — only `=== true` is treated as regenerate.

CreateCoupleInviteRequest.description: Body may be empty or omitted; App currently sends no body.

originalDate.description: Real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, year 1000–9999; invalid dates return 400

AnniversaryPayload.description: Used for both create and update (full replacement, not partial)

description.description: DB null serialized as empty string

cover.description: Short-lived signed URL for a private object-key cover; legacy URL is returned unchanged

locationName.description: DB null serialized as empty string

budgetAmount.description: Integer budget in yuan; null means not set

createdAt.description:
Backend `formatDateTime` may return null. App TypeScript currently
marks this as non-null string — contract follows backend.

cover.description: Legacy URL cover, retained for backward compatibility; omitted for private object-key covers

coverObjectKey.description: Private uploaded album media object key; must belong to the authenticated uploader

title.description: Updated wish title; trimmed by the server

description.description: Updated wish description; an empty string clears it

targetDate.description: Updated target date; a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, year 1000–9999

budgetAmount.description: Updated integer budget in yuan; null clears the budget

locationName.description: Updated location name; an empty string clears the name without changing coordinates

coverObjectKey.description: Private album object key to replace the cover; null clears the legacy URL and private key; omitted leaves the cover unchanged

UpdateWishRequest.description: PATCH at least one supported field: title, status, description, targetDate, budgetAmount, locationName, or coverObjectKey

objectKey.description: Private uploaded album object key; new clients should use this field

url.description: Legacy URL input retained for older clients

id.description:
Positive for DB rows. Legacy wish_records.media_urls synthesis may
produce negative ids — treat as opaque identifiers.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL for object-key media (300 seconds); legacy media may return its existing URL

thumbnailUrl.description: Empty for object-key media without a stored cross-device thumbnail

takenAt.description:
Date-only when set; empty string when unset
(backend formatDateOnly returns "" for null — not JSON null)

objectKey.description: Object storage key returned by the authenticated upload endpoint

coverMediaType.description: Media type of the selected cover, or null when unset

coverUrl.description: Short-lived signed URL for an object-key cover (300 seconds); legacy stories may return their existing URL

coverThumbnailUrl.description: Empty for object-key covers without a stored cross-device thumbnail

photos.description: Count of image media (API name photos, not photoCount)

objectKey.description: Object storage key returned by the authenticated upload endpoint

UploadMediaResponse.description: Success body returns a private object key only; it has NO `url` or `message` field.

PartnerChatClientMessageAudio.description: Exactly one form is accepted: new private object key or legacy URL.

audioObjectKey.description: Must belong to the authenticated sender.

audioUrl.description: Legacy URL form; mutually exclusive with audioObjectKey.

nextBeforeId.description: Oldest returned server message ID when older messages remain.

id.description: Server message ID as a string.

audioUrl.description: Legacy URL only; omitted for private key-backed audio.

deliveryStatus.description: Persisted status relative to the authenticated requester.

url.description: 300-second signed URL for private objects; legacy URL otherwise.

expiresIn.description: Present only when the URL is a short-lived signed URL.

messageId.description: Positive safe-integer server message ID as a string.

deliveryAckVersion.description: Present when receiver delivery acknowledgement is supported.

PartnerChatServerError.description: WS errors include `code`; HTTP errors currently do not

bearerAuth.description:
JWT from `POST /user/login`. Payload `sub` is the user id as a string.
Header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
